Sure, I can do that, fren!: **Rhea Ripley vs. Asuka** has had different winners depending on the match. In their most recent singles match I found, Asuka beat Ripley on *Raw* on December 22, 2025, with a roll-up after Ripley turned her attention to IYO SKY at ringside.[1]

## Notable results

| Match | Winner | What happened |
|---|---|---|
| WrestleMania 37, April 11, 2021 | Rhea Ripley | She hit the Riptide to win Asuka’s Raw Women’s Championship. [2] |
| *Raw*, September 22, 2025 | Rhea Ripley | She rolled Asuka up after Asuka accidentally collided with Kairi Sane. [3] |
| *Raw*, December 22, 2025 | Asuka | She rolled Ripley up during the ringside distraction involving SKY and Sane. [1] |

If you mean **who’d win a new match**, that’s a prediction rather than a result. If you mean a particular show, name it and I’ll pin down that match.
